def count_no_of_ways(n, k):
    if n == 0:
        return 0
    if n == 1:
        return k

    # Initialize the DP table
    dp = [[0] * k for _ in range(n)]

    # Base case: there are k ways to paint the first post with any of the k colors
    for j in range(k):
        dp[0][j] = 1

    # Fill the DP table
    for i in range(1, n):
        for j in range(k):
            dp[i][j] = dp[i - 1][j] * (k - 1)  # Previous post has a different color
            dp[i][j] += dp[i - 1][j] * (k - 1)  # Previous post has the same color

    # Sum up all the ways to paint the last post
    total_ways = sum(dp[n - 1])

    return total_ways
